Relocation Reference — Complete Guide

movein.website · Every step, expanded for reference

Your journey through settling in — UK, US, Singapore, Dubai, Australia, Canada, India, South Africa, Mexico, Hong Kong, Japan, Malaysia & all 27 EU countries

Relocation Reference is a free, step-by-step guide covering: booking your first stay before you fly, airport arrival and taxis, opening a bank account, registering with local health and ID systems, getting a SIM card, driving licence rules, sending money home, finding housing, public transport, schools, and the everyday apps you'll use once you're settled. Pick your destination above to personalise every step to your city — including any of the 27 European Union member states, from France and Germany to Malta and Cyprus.

This guide is curated and consolidated from information publicly available across the internet — official government sites, banks, telecoms and transport operators, and community sources.
